address: 8F Gyeonghuidang, 36 Gyeonghuigung-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, 03175, South Korea
bio: JUEUN offers a delicate expression of Korea’s four seasons, favouring a classic, understated approach over trends or ornamentation. A variety of fermented sauces form the backbone of the menu, enhancing ingredients with natural depth and harmony, while the seasonally changing courses provide a strong incentive for return visits. The meal follows a thoughtful progression and concludes with a traditional Korean table that highlights a wide spectrum of flavours. Ceramics by local artists and subtle media art create a space where tradition and modernity coexist with quiet elegance. The curated pairings of traditional Korean spirits and wine further elevate the experience....
